report_metadata.title: Polarix Bharati ML Scenario Validation & Final Evaluation Report

scenarios.input_condition: Normal continuous diurnal telemetry across all 5 Bharati sensors over 30 observations.
scenarios.expected_behavior: First 29 steps return INSUFFICIENT_DATA; 30th step executes scored LSTM inference producing NORMAL status with MSE <= threshold.
scenarios.pass_fail_criterion: All 5 sensors complete 30-step warmup and produce scored NORMAL status with MSE <= threshold.
scenarios.notes_and_limitations: Evaluated on stationary baseline telemetry with normal synthetic variance.

scenarios.input_condition: Sudden high-magnitude step jump (+55°C thermal excursion) arriving on active 30-step history.
scenarios.expected_behavior: LSTM reconstruction error sharply exceeds threshold, triggering ANOMALY status and SPIKE anomaly-type classification.
scenarios.notes_and_limitations: Isolated transient extreme spike reliably detected by both LSTM autoencoder and heuristic classifier.

scenarios.input_condition: Sustained linear monotonic ramp across 30 consecutive observations (gradual sensor drift).
scenarios.expected_behavior: LSTM sequence autoencoder detects temporal trajectory divergence, outputting ANOMALY status with DRIFT or UNKNOWN category.
scenarios.notes_and_limitations: Demonstrates temporal memory advantage over static baseline which adapts trailing mean.

scenarios.input_condition: Sensor flatline condition with 15 consecutive identical floating point values (zero local variance).
scenarios.expected_behavior: Contract processes successfully; flatline condition analyzed by physical heuristics (low standard deviation check).
scenarios.pass_fail_criterion: Contract executes successfully and anomaly_status in {'NORMAL', 'ANOMALY'}.
scenarios.notes_and_limitations: Mid-range flatlines produce low autoencoder reconstruction loss; classification relies on secondary variance heuristics.

scenarios.input_condition: Telemetry dropout event where sensor value is None and quality flag is 'MISSING'.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Inference returns MISSING_DATA with null anomaly_score and null anomaly_type, immediately flushing the rolling buffer to 0.
scenarios.pass_fail_criterion: anomaly_status == 'MISSING_DATA', anomaly_score is None, and buffer length resets to 0.
scenarios.notes_and_limitations: Prevents corrupted, discontinuous windows from poisoning downstream LSTM evaluations.

scenarios.input_condition: Telemetry observation arriving on cold sensor buffer with fewer than 30 observations.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA with null anomaly_score and null anomaly_type, safely accumulating buffer.
scenarios.pass_fail_criterion: anomaly_status == 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA', anomaly_score is None, and buffer length == 1.
scenarios.notes_and_limitations: Model forward pass is completely bypassed until sequence buffer is full.

scenarios.input_condition: Duplicate telemetry with identical (station_id, sensor_id, timestamp) arriving repeatedly.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Raises DuplicateTelemetryError; rejects input and preserves internal sliding window state without duplicate injection.
scenarios.pass_fail_criterion: DuplicateTelemetryError raised, buffer preserved at 1, and diagnostic event == 'DUPLICATE'.
scenarios.notes_and_limitations: Guarantees chronological uniqueness across all sensor streams.

scenarios.input_condition: Out-of-order telemetry with timestamp earlier than the latest recorded observation.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Raises StaleTelemetryError; rejects out-of-order packet without corrupting chronological sequence.
scenarios.pass_fail_criterion: StaleTelemetryError raised, buffer preserved at 1, and diagnostic event == 'STALE'.
scenarios.notes_and_limitations: Protects temporal LSTM sequence ordering against network transport reordering.

scenarios.input_condition: Malformed payloads: unknown station ID, unsupported sensor ID, and NaN floating point value.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Contract validation rejects unsupported station/sensor with explicit exceptions; NaN value safely handled as MISSING_DATA.
scenarios.pass_fail_criterion: UnsupportedStationError & UnsupportedSensorError raised; NaN value routed to MISSING_DATA with null score.
scenarios.notes_and_limitations: Comprehensive guardrails protect pipeline boundary against malformed backend traffic.

scenarios.input_condition: Interleaved multi-sensor stream with differing sequence accumulation rates (30, 30, 20, 10, 5).
scenarios.expected_behavior: Each sensor maintains an isolated rolling buffer; no buffer cross-contamination or history leakage occurs.
scenarios.pass_fail_criterion: Buffers exactly match input counts (TEMP=30, PRESS=30, HUM=20, VIB=10, POWER=5).
scenarios.notes_and_limitations: Ensures concurrent sensor stream safety in multi-threaded or asynchronous orchestrators.

scenarios.input_condition: Valid 30-step stream -> MISSING telemetry dropout -> valid 30-step stream recovery.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Pipeline cleanly flushes buffer on dropout, enters warmup phase, and reliably resumes scored inference after 30 new observations.
scenarios.pass_fail_criterion: Post-dropout warmup returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA, 30th resumed point returns NORMAL with buffer=30.
scenarios.notes_and_limitations: Verifies state machine recovery lifecycle without manual service re-instantiation.

scenarios.input_condition: Identical synthetic telemetry sequence processed through two independent, cleanly initialized service instances.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Both instances produce identical anomaly_status, anomaly_type, and anomaly_score across every time step.
scenarios.pass_fail_criterion: 100% agreement across all 34 sequence steps between service instance 1 and instance 2.
scenarios.notes_and_limitations: Demonstrates pure deterministic execution without random initialization or non-deterministic inference states.

comparative_tradeoff_summary: Z-Score Baseline: High precision (71.67%) and very low false alarm rate (1.44%), but low recall (13.56%) due to rolling mean adaptation during gradual drift.
LSTM Autoencoder: High temporal sensitivity and strong recall (57.09% overall; 100% on sharp spikes, 48.7% on drifts), but higher false alarm rate (50.50%) on synthetic diurnal cycles.
Heuristic Classifier: Isolates stuck values (75% recall) and missing telemetry (100% recall) via dedicated feature rules where reconstruction loss is uninformative.

limitations.synthetic_telemetry_only: All evaluations, benchmarks, and metrics are derived strictly from synthetic Antarctic telemetry. No real Antarctic station operational telemetry was used.
limitations.no_production_accuracy_claim: Metrics reflect mathematical operating characteristics under synthetic evaluation workloads and do not constitute field-certified accuracy or production SLAs.
limitations.frozen_artifacts: Model weights, scaler statistics, decision threshold (0.013215307652775843), and sequence length (30) remain strictly frozen without post-hoc tuning.
limitations.real_world_transferability: Real Antarctic environmental noise, multi-sensor coupling, and unmodeled hardware failure modes will differ from synthetic distributions.
